headline: Continued hearings on projects at 61-69 Suffolk, 230-232 Beech, and 956 Dwight streets, and 120 Pine Street
summary: Two lot division plans, on Charles Hill Road and Sun Valley Road, were approved. A proposed native plants zoning change was continued to November 10 so members can meet with Councilor Meg Magrath-Smith. Hearings on parking, zone change, and fence height requests were continued to October 27, 2026.
decisions: Continued the parking special permit for 61-69 Suffolk Street to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
Continued discussion of the Notice of Decision for a fence height special permit at 230-232 Beech Street to October 27, 2026.
Continued the parking special permit for 956 Dwight Street to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the zone change for 120 & 0 Pine Street, from BL to BH, to October 27, 2026.
Continued the native plants zoning text change to November 10, 2026, 5-0.
Approved the ANR for a rear lot division on Charles Hill Road, parcels 29, 35, and 36, 5-0.
Approved the ANR for a parcel join on Sun Valley Road, parcels 136 and 137, 5-0.
Continued approval of the minutes of 3/28/2023, 4/9/2024, 5/14/2024, and 4/23/2024 to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
Scheduled the next major review for November 10 and a tentative meeting for December 1 or 15.

The motion carried 5-0 by roll call vote
